invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.7.0 retains the complete 2.6 customer-credit payment baseline and deepens recurring billing with per-occurrence run ledgers, idempotent generated invoices, schedule start/end and maximum-occurrence controls, retry backoff, failure telemetry, automatic pause after configurable retry exhaustion, manual retry, terminal completion/cancellation semantics, approval-aware posting, generated-invoice links, delivery outcome history, and a production operator UI. Future changes must keep Invoicing, ERP integration, platform closure, app-surface, visibility, core-hardening, TypeScript, migration dry-run and production deployment gates green.
